content.comment_body: Hi, I've just started using [product_name], and when I open the Message text box, I don't see options for [product_name], TD, or both, so the message isn't showing up on my TD display. I noticed this feature works in some demo programs and shows properly on my TD. I've selected [article_no] but I assume there's another setting I missed. Probably just one more step! Thanks in advance. [user_name]
Hello, Simply go to File > Message Text Settings and enable the new feature. Regards,
Issue resolved. Thank you very much for your assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: The user was unsure why some expected options were missing from the Message text box while configuring the display settings for [product_name] TD. This confusion resulted from not enabling a new feature in the software, creating a mismatch between what appeared in demo programs and in their own setup. Quick guidance from another forum user helped them resolve the issue, resulting in a positive outcome.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the Message text box to provide options to configure messages for [product_name], TD, or both, as seen in demo programs, and to display messages properly on the TD.
